onboarding.welcome_body: Sapu shows you what fills your disk, cleans what is safe, and removes duplicate files. Everything it removes can be restored.
onboarding.profile_body: This only changes how much detail you see. You can switch any time.
onboarding.profile_general_hint: Plain language, sensible defaults picked for you.
onboarding.profile_developer_hint: Docker, node_modules, package caches, build output.
onboarding.profile_suggested: Suggested: we found {{tools}} on this computer.
onboarding.access_body_macos: macOS stops apps from reading some folders. To let Sapu see the whole disk, grant Full Disk Access.
onboarding.access_body_windows: Sapu works without admin rights. Running as administrator makes scans faster and more complete, but it is optional.
onboarding.access_body_linux: Sapu only reads folders your account can access. System folders are shown for information only.
onboarding.access_steps_macos_1: Click the button above to open System Settings.
onboarding.access_steps_macos_2: Turn on the switch next to Sapu.
onboarding.access_steps_macos_3: Come back here. The status updates automatically.
onboarding.safety_trash: Everything removed goes to the Trash / Recycle Bin, never deleted outright.
onboarding.safety_history: Every clean-up is logged in History, so you can restore it.
onboarding.safety_protected: System folders and personal data are protected. Sapu will never touch them.
onboarding.safety_preview: You always see a summary before anything is removed.
onboarding.ai_body: AI only suggests and explains. It can never delete files. Only file names, sizes and ages are sent, never file contents.
onboarding.ai_cloud: Cloud with your own API key
onboarding.ai_cloud_hint: Metadata is sent to the provider you choose.
onboarding.scan_body: The first scan shows what is taking up space. Nothing is removed at this stage.
onboarding.scan_unavailable: Scanning arrives in the next version. For now, explore History and Settings.

home.title: Home
home.empty_body: Scanning is being built. Settings and History are ready to use.

history.title: Clean-up history
history.empty_body: Every clean-up will be listed here so you can restore it.
history.restore_unsupported: On macOS, open the Trash in Finder to restore files.

settings.title: Settings
settings.protected_body: Sapu will never remove these, no matter what.
